cover.prompt: The stoa of the scholars' coast seen from above: scholars in grey stand talking in pairs between its plain columns, and on the beaten ground before it pairs of copyists sit facing each other across long stone tables with scrolls unrolled between them; cypresses and the sea beyond

r.prompt: scholar and librarian sit facing each other at one of the stone tables, comparing their scrolls; tholos-runner runs past in the distance.
r.others: more scholars in grey and librarians in cream seated in pairs at many of the other tables, comparing scrolls.

p01-library.prompt: A small library of weathered plaster on a base of dressed stone, with two plain columns in antis framing a door left open to the sea; within, racks of papyrus scrolls; outside, an olive tree casts pale shade on the threshold

p02-festival.prompt: Festival day on the ground below the stoa, seen down the length of the tables: scholars from different libraries sit facing each other with scrolls unrolled, arguing points with gestures of the hand, while behind them others walk in pairs under the olive trees; the sea calm in the afternoon light

r.prompt: scholar and librarian sit facing each other across the table, their scrolls unrolled on the rests, comparing them line by line.
r.others: more pairs of scholars and librarians at the tables beyond.

p03-stoa.prompt: On the festival ground before the stoa, small groups of travellers and scholars walk between the stone tables; one scholar points with his stylus toward the hills, another reads from a wax tablet; beyond, the long colonnade of the stoa catches the late sun

r.prompt: From the shade of the stoa, scholar walks out towards the tables with a scroll under his arm.
r.others: small groups of scholars walking between the tables in the distance.

p04-coast.prompt: The coast seen from above: libraries with red roofs scattered through the olive groves, pale footpaths winding between them, the blue water of the bay stretching out toward the two northern arms of Paxos

r.prompt: Nobody is visible at this distance.
